scope: Fixture-only semantic text and reading order; no rendered accessibility claim

guidance.bundled: Edit the bundled selection, validate configuration, and restart. Running selection does not change.
guidance.custom: Add the provider package and registration, rebuild, redeploy, and restart. No hot installation.
guidance.runtime: Investigate dependencies and the existing lifecycle report, then explicitly reassess readiness.
guidance.rollback: Remove discovery opt-in and restart. This does not roll back cached data.
guidance.permission: Management-read permission does not grant execution permission.
guidance.freshness: Receipt age over 30 seconds or failed refresh disables retained actions.
